metadata.title: Particle in a Box: Where the n² Energy Formula Comes From (Worked Example)
metadata.thing: a standing-wave-in-a-box whose energy ladder is first shown qualitatively, then derived into E_n = n^2 h^2 / 8mL^2, then worked with real numbers for an electron in a 1 nm box, then tied to quantum-dot color
metadata.color_notes: Wave + rungs + formula highlight = accent Warm Slate #5A5653. The n^2 / final-answer emphasis = red #C0392B. Axes, labels, numbers = ink #1a1a1a. Math is MathTex (LaTeX); prose/labels are Shadows Into Light.
metadata.math_rendering: All formulas render as Manim MathTex (LaTeX, MacTeX). Text/labels render in Shadows Into Light. See `math_tex` per beat.

beats.narration_text:
Bear's Notes

Why quantum energy levels grow as n squared
beats.tts_normalized_text:
Bear's Notes.

Why quantum energy levels grow as n squared.
beats.new_visual_element: infographic title card: brand + an n^2 energy-ladder hero motif + title
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: Bear's Notes brand, a small energy ladder whose rungs fan as n^2 draws in, then the title in Shadows Into Light.

beats.narration_text: You'd expect a ladder of energy rungs to be evenly spaced, like a normal ladder.
beats.tts_normalized_text: You'd expect a ladder of energy rungs to be evenly spaced, like a normal ladder.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: narration card + four evenly spaced accent rungs.

beats.narration_text: But a quantum box's rungs fan apart the higher you climb.
beats.tts_normalized_text: But a quantum box's rungs fan apart the higher you climb.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: narration card + rungs that fan apart upward.

beats.narration_text: A particle trapped in a box can only be the standing waves that fit exactly.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A particle trapped in a box can only be the standing waves that fit exactly.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw box walls; the n=1 half-wave fills the box.

beats.narration_text: The lowest fits half a wave; the next a full wave; then one and a half.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The lowest fits half a wave; the next a full wave; then one and a half.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: Transform the wave through n=1..4, n-label updating.

beats.narration_text: Its energy climbs as one, four, nine, sixteen — the squares.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Its energy climbs as one, four, nine, sixteen — the squares.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: an energy axis appears at right; rungs land at 1,4,9,16 with values.

beats.narration_text: The gaps — three, five, seven — keep widening.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The gaps — three, five, seven — keep widening.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: red double-arrows mark gaps 3,5,7 between the rungs.

beats.narration_text: Let's turn that picture into a formula.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Let's turn that picture into a formula.
beats.new_visual_element: clean slate: the box with the n half-wave + space for math
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: keep a single box+wave on the left, clear the right for the derivation.

beats.narration_text: Level n fits n half-waves across a box of width L.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Level n fits n half-waves across a box of width L.
beats.new_visual_element: label the box width L and count n half-waves
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: brace the box width as L (MathTex), annotate the n half-waves.

beats.narration_text: So its wavelength is lambda-n equals two L over n.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So its wavelength is lambda n equals two L over n.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: Write the MathTex lambda_n = 2L/n.

beats.narration_text: More half-waves means a shorter wavelength.
beats.tts_normalized_text: More half-waves means a shorter wavelength.
beats.new_visual_element: indicate lambda shrinking as n grows
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: brief Indicate on lambda_n and the wave compressing.

beats.narration_text: A shorter wavelength means more momentum: p equals h over lambda.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A shorter wavelength means more momentum: p equals h over lambda.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: Write MathTex p = h/lambda below the first line.

beats.narration_text: And kinetic energy grows as momentum squared — E equals p-squared over two m.
beats.tts_normalized_text: And kinetic energy grows as momentum squared — E equals p squared over two m.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: Write MathTex E = p^2/(2m).

beats.narration_text: Substitute, and the n lands upstairs, squared.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Substitute, and the n lands upstairs, squared.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: TransformMatchingTex chaining lambda_n into p into E.

beats.narration_text: E-n equals n-squared times h-squared over eight m L-squared.
beats.tts_normalized_text: E n equals n squared times h squared over eight m L squared.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: resolve to MathTex E_n = n^2 h^2 / (8 m L^2); box it in accent.

beats.narration_text: The n-squared isn't an accident — energy goes as one over the wavelength squared, and the wavelength shrinks as one over n.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The n squared isn't an accident — energy goes as one over the wavelength squared, and the wavelength shrinks as one over n.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: Indicate the n^2 in red, trace it back to lambda_n = 2L/n.

beats.narration_text: Now let's put real numbers on it.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Now let's put real numbers on it.
beats.new_visual_element: the boxed formula re-centered for substitution
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: carry the result formula to the top, clear room below for numbers.

beats.narration_text: Take an electron in a box one nanometer wide.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Take an electron in a box one nanometer wide.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: write the givens (electron mass m, L = 1 nm) as MathTex.

beats.narration_text: Plug in: the ground state, E-one, is about zero point three eight electron-volts.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Plug in: the ground state, E one, is about zero point three eight electron volts.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: substitute n=1; reveal MathTex E_1 approx 0.38 eV; mark its rung.

beats.narration_text: The second level is four times that — about one point five electron-volts.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The second level is four times that — about one point five electron volts.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: MathTex E_2 = 4 E_1 approx 1.5 eV; mark its rung higher.

beats.narration_text: So the jump from level one to level two costs about one point one electron-volts.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So the jump from level one to level two costs about one point one electron volts.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: red arrow between rungs 1 and 2; MathTex Delta E approx 1.1 eV.

beats.narration_text: That energy leaves as a single photon.
beats.tts_normalized_text: That energy leaves as a single photon.
beats.new_visual_element: a photon emitted from the transition
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: a wavy photon arrow leaves the gap.

beats.narration_text: Its wavelength is h c over E — about eleven hundred nanometers.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Its wavelength is h c over delta E — about eleven hundred nanometers.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: MathTex lambda = hc/Delta E approx 1100 nm.

beats.narration_text: Near-infrared light, set entirely by the size of the box.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Near-infrared light, set entirely by the size of the box.
beats.new_visual_element: place 1100 nm on a tiny spectrum, near-IR
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: a small spectrum strip; mark ~1100 nm in the near-IR.

beats.narration_text: This is exactly how a quantum dot works.
beats.tts_normalized_text: This is exactly how a quantum dot works.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a small dot/box labeled 'quantum dot'.

beats.narration_text: Shrink the box and every energy scales up as one over L squared.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Shrink the box and every energy scales up as one over L squared.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: MathTex E proportional to 1/L^2.

beats.narration_text: Smaller dots jump higher and glow bluer; larger dots glow redder.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Smaller dots jump higher and glow bluer; larger dots glow redder.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: two boxes side by side; small one's rungs higher + blue glow, large one red.

beats.narration_text: A quantum dot's color is just this formula, made visible.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A quantum dot's color is just this formula, made visible.
beats.new_visual_element: callback to E_n formula beside the dots
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: bring back the boxed formula next to the two glowing dots.

beats.narration_text: So the rungs fan out as n-squared because energy lives in the square of the momentum.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So the rungs fan out as n squared because energy lives in the square of the momentum.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: recap line + MathTex E ~ p^2 with the fanning ladder.

beats.narration_text: And momentum climbs with every half-wave you add to the box.
beats.tts_normalized_text: And momentum climbs with every half-wave you add to the box.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: a half-wave adds, the momentum/energy tick up.

beats.narration_text: Same picture as the short — now with the numbers behind it.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Same picture as the short — now with the numbers behind it.
beats.new_visual_element: the boxed result formula one last time
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: the boxed formula settles center as the closer.

beats.narration_text: Thanks for watching — find more Bear's Notes at youtube.com/@NikBearBrown.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Thanks for watching — find more Bear's Notes at youtube dot com slash at Nik Bear Brown.
beats.new_visual_element: separate cleared outro card: thanks + title + channel
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: clear canvas; 'Thanks for watching' + title + youtube.com/@NikBearBrown.
